inventory.description: One schematic top-view ring apparatus, not multiple subfigures or multiple expanding orbits. An empty central opening is surrounded by four curved bands separated at the top, bottom, left and right by short straight connections.
required_relationships: Four curved quadrants remain arranged around the same central opening.
The four intervening straight regions form one closed ring with the curved regions.
No spiral or changing-radius succession of particle orbits.

inventory.description: Four annular curved magnet-sector bands: upper-left, upper-right, lower-right and lower-left. Each has solid inner and outer boundaries and broken curved internal detailing. Two broken curved internal strokes are visible within each band; they are not separately labelled particle trajectories.
required_relationships: All four bands are preserved.
The magnet callout targets the lower-left curved band.
Broken internal strokes are distinguished from the solid sector edges; do not invent a quantified field or extra source orbit from them.

required_relationships: Accelerating apparatus is on the upper straight section, not on a curved magnet sector.
The callout identifies the apparatus, not a particle or an answer.

inventory.description: A second unlabelled rectangular block bridges the bottom straight interruption, with short flanking connections to the two lower curved bands.
required_relationships: The bottom block remains present and on the same closed ring.

inventory.description: A short vertical right straight ring section joins the right curved bands. A short external extraction branch leaves this right straight region toward the upper right. The extraction label is printed vertically at the far right.
required_relationships: Extraction is connected to the right straight region.
The external branch and the right ring straight are distinct but connected.
